description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for MergeKingdom — Godot 4 GDScript

rules.name: Building removal without symmetric economy reversal
rules.message: Building removal does not reverse idle_earning_rate — infinite money exploit
rules.suggestion: Subtract building.earning_rate from idle_earning_rate in the removal function

rules.name: IAP receipt generation without platform API call
rules.message: IAP returns hardcoded stub receipt — no real purchase validation
rules.suggestion: Call Google Play Billing or App Store StoreKit API for real receipt validation

rules.name: Signal connected to non-existent method
rules.message: Signal connected to method that doesn't exist in the target script
rules.suggestion: Add the method or fix the signal connection path

rules.name: Resource path in scene without file existence
rules.message: load() references a resource path that does not exist in the project
rules.suggestion: Verify the file exists at the res:// path, or add the missing asset

rules.name: Economy cost exceeding reachable maximum
rules.message: Economy cost exceeds maximum reachable balance — progression is impossible without purchases
rules.suggestion: Verify cost <= (starting_balance + max_earnable_before_gate) with an economy balance test
